file_type: PE32+ (x86-64) console executable for MS Windows (MinGW-w64 / GCC 13.2, built with debug symbols from source 'windows_level20_RemotePEExecution.c')

encryption_details.algorithm: RC4 (custom rc4_init/rc4_crypt routines, standard RC4 KSA/PRGA)
encryption_details.key_storage: Hardcoded in .rdata as g_rc4_key (VA 0x140005000). The 16-byte key is the leading portion of the obfuscated string 'R3m0t3_PE_3x3c_Kntdll.dll' (leetspeak for 'Remote_PE_Exec_Kntdll.dll'); the trailing substring 'ntdll.dll' is reused as the module name for NT API resolution. Payload: 64-byte RC4-encrypted blob g_encrypted_pe in .data (VA 0x140004000), decrypted in-place with rc4_crypt(state, g_encrypted_pe, 64).

anti_analysis: anti_sandbox: GetModuleHandleA('sbiedll.dll') - detects Sandboxie and returns 1
sleep_evasion: Sleep(30000ms) then exit when sandbox detected (WinMain)
string_obfuscation: leetspeak-encoded key string 'R3m0t3_PE_3x3c_K...' and RC4-encrypted embedded payload
dynamic_api_resolution: NT APIs not imported, resolved at runtime via GetModuleHandleA/GetProcAddress

injection_details.method: Remote PE image injection (manual PE write + remote thread): OpenProcess(0x43A = PROCESS_CREATE_THREAD|PROCESS_QUERY_INFORMATION|PROCESS_VM_OPERATION|PROCESS_VM_READ|PROCESS_VM_WRITE), VirtualAllocEx(MEM_RESERVE|MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE) in target, write PE headers (SizeOfHeaders) and each section (VirtualAddress/PointerToRawData/SizeOfRawData) via NtWriteVirtualMemory, apply IMAGE_REL_BASED_DIR64 base relocations (ReadProcessMemory old value + delta, NtWriteVirtualMemory new value), then CreateRemoteThread at remote_base + AddressOfEntryPoint. Not DLL injection and not process hollowing (no CreateProcess/suspend/PEB write).
injection_details.payload_write: NtWriteVirtualMemory (resolved from ntdll.dll) into VirtualAllocEx'd region in the target process; payload is the RC4-decrypted 64-byte PE stub stored at g_encrypted_pe
injection_details.post_execution: WaitForSingleObject(hThread, 10000), CloseHandle(hThread), NtClose(hProcess); VirtualFreeEx + NtClose on error paths
injection_details.entry_point_param: CreateRemoteThread lpParameter = remote_base (payload receives its own image base as argument)
